read.thesis: Ally's Q3 shows record auto applications and 10% origination growth, but CECL build, lease residual pressure and rising early delinquencies offset; FY NIM narrowed to 3.6–3.65% and earning-asset growth raised to 5–6%.

triggers.label: Originated yield 9.44%, up ~35bp QoQ
triggers.quote: Third quarter originated yield of 9.44% was up approximately 35 basis points quarter over quarter.

triggers.label: Earning asset growth guide raised to 5–6%
triggers.quote: We now anticipate 5% to 6% growth year over year up from 3% to 5% previously

triggers.label: Applications up 20% to 4.8M
triggers.quote: we decisioned 4.8 million applications up 20% year over year

triggers.label: FY NIM narrowed to 3.6–3.65%
triggers.quote: now expecting full year NIM to fall between 3.6% and 3.65%

triggers.label: Early-life delinquencies up in late-25/early-26 vintages
triggers.quote: our late 25 and early 2 thousand 26 vintages are showing higher early life delinquency

triggers.label: Lease residual pressure persists into Q4
triggers.quote: we expect the resulting pressure to persist into 4Q

guidance.quote: We now anticipate 5% to 6% growth year over year up from 3% to 5% previously
now expecting full year NIM to fall between 3.6% and 3.65%
As we look to the fourth quarter, we see NIM around 3.7%
we are tightening our outlook to be up 2% to 4% compared to our prior guide of flat to up 5%
adjusted noninterest expense is now expected to be flat to up 1% slightly lower than the prior guide
Our outlook for retail NCOs remains consistent as we track toward the midpoint of our guidance range.
we continue to expect our full year rate to land in the 20% to 22% range

prior_guidance_check.quote: we continue to expect NIM to remain within our initial guide
We are very much performing towards the middle of the guide
we continue to expect our full year rate to land in the 20% to 22% range

red_flags.label: Early-life delinquency rising in late-25/early-26 vintages
red_flags.quote: our late 25 and early 2 thousand 26 vintages are showing higher early life delinquency

red_flags.label: Lease residual pressure from Stellantis returns
red_flags.quote: reflecting continued pressure on the Stellantis' auction prices and residual values

evasions.quote: we are certainly not gonna give 2027 guidance right now at this point
it is not pointing you toward you know, kind of basis-point precision
